verdicts_or_reports.screen: File properties dialog (folder properties) – opened for empty folder Audiobooks/Alarms in /storage/emulated/0
verdicts_or_reports.element: Size line (t7) in the Properties dialog
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Size should read "0 items; 0 B" for an empty folder.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Size reads "items; 0 B" – the item count "0" is missing from the string.
steps: Open Amaze File Manager at /storage/emulated/0.
Tap the three-dot button on the empty folder Alarms (or Audiobooks).
Tap Properties.
Look at the Size line: it shows "items; 0 B" with no item count.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Main file list at /storage/emulated/0 after leaving the "Images" category view via the toolbar Home button
verdicts_or_reports.element: Pink "+" floating action button (sd_main_fab) that should be in the bottom-right of the file list
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After leaving the Images category view the file list should switch back to normal folder controls and show the pink "+" FAB again (as it does when leaving the category with the system Back key).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The root folder list is shown (path /storage/emulated/0, "14 folders and 0 files") but the pink "+" FAB is gone; only the folder rows are present. Entering Images and pressing system Back brings the FAB back, so leaving via the Home toolbar button leaves the list in the category-view control state.
steps: From /storage/emulated/0, open the navigation drawer and tap the Images category.
In the Images view (path shows "Images"), tap the Home button in the toolbar (house icon, top right).
The file list returns to /storage/emulated/0 ("14 folders and 0 files") but the pink + FAB is no longer displayed in the bottom-right corner.
Repeat by entering Images and pressing system Back: the FAB is displayed again, confirming the Home-button route is what leaves the control hidden.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: File list /storage/emulated/0/AndroidQA/Amaze – multi-select action bar after rotating the device
verdicts_or_reports.element: Multi-select action bar selection counter ("0" / "Amaze Debug" | "0")
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The 3 selected items (notes.txt, keep.jpg, photo.jpg) should stay selected with the counter showing 3 after rotation. If selection cannot survive rotation, multi-select mode should close instead of staying active.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After rotating with 3 files selected, the files are no longer highlighted and the multi-select action bar remains open showing a count of "0". Rotating back to portrait keeps this broken state (action bar visible, counter 0, no items selected).
steps: Go to /storage/emulated/0/AndroidQA/Amaze.
Long-press notes.txt, then tap keep.jpg and photo.jpg so the action bar shows 3 selected.
Rotate the device to landscape.
Observe the multi-select action bar now shows "0" and no item is highlighted.
Rotate back to portrait: the action bar is still present with "0" and no selection.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Main file list at /storage/emulated/0 after returning from the "Images" category view
verdicts_or_reports.element: Header folder/file count under the path (/storage/emulated/0)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Returning from the Images category view should restore the normal folder list exactly as it was, with its existing show-hidden-files setting. Before entering Images the root showed "28 folders and 0 files"; it should still show 28 folders after Back.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After tapping the Images category in the navigation drawer and pressing system Back, the root file list shows "14 folders and 0 files" – hidden folders are no longer listed, so the file list's show-hidden-files state was reset by entering/leaving the category view.
steps: Launch Amaze File Manager fresh; it opens /storage/emulated/0 and the header reads "28 folders and 0 files".
Open the navigation drawer and tap the Images category.
In the Images view ("0 folders and 2 files"), press the system Back key.

The app returns to /storage/emulated/0 but the header now reads "14 folders and 0 files" and the hidden folders are gone. Relaunching the app restores 28 again, confirming the category visit changed the setting.

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Main file list at /storage/emulated/0 immediately after launching Amaze File Manager
verdicts_or_reports.element: Header summary line under the path (/storage/emulated/0)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The header should report the actual number of folders in the list: "14 folders and 0 files" (the list contains exactly Alarms, Android, AndroidQA, Audiobooks, DCIM, Documents, Download, Movies, Music, Notifications, Pictures, Podcasts, Recordings, Ringtones).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The header reports "28 folders and 0 files" although the scrolled list ends at Ringtones and contains only 14 folders. After entering a drawer category view and returning, the same list correctly reports "14 folders and 0 files", confirming the initial count is doubled.
steps: Exit Amaze (overflow > Exit) and launch it again from the launcher.
It opens /storage/emulated/0 and the header shows "28 folders and 0 files".
Scroll to the bottom of the list: it ends at Ringtones, with only 14 folder rows total.
Open the drawer, tap Images, then press Back: the same root list now shows "14 folders and 0 files".

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Properties dialog opened from the navigation drawer's Internal Storage row (storage usage graph icon)
verdicts_or_reports.element: Size line in the storage volume Properties dialog
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The Size value should agree with the storage breakdown shown in the same dialog: Total 452 GB with 82.54 GB used and 369 GB free. It should show the content/volume size (e.g. 82.54 GB used or 452 GB total), not repeat the free-space figure.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The Size line reads "16 items; 369 GB" – the 369 GB is precisely the free-space value from the chart below (Total: 452 GB, used space 82.54 GB, free space 369 GB), so the volume/folder size is reported as free space instead of its actual size.
steps: Open the navigation drawer in Amaze (Internal Storage is listed as "369 GB free of 452 GB").
Tap the storage usage graph icon on the right side of the Internal Storage row.
The Properties dialog opens showing Name "0", Location "/storage/emulated", Size "16 items; 369 GB", Date "Nov 14 | 6:56 AM".
Compare the Size line with the same dialog's chart: Total 452 GB, used space 82.54 GB, free space 369 GB – Size repeats the free-space figure, not the volume/folder content size.
